# `intent wb`

**Generated by `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/gen_reference.sh` at 2026-09-25 12:48Z. Do not edit -- re-run it.**

The whiteboard: read the node boards, and send between them

|                                      |                                                     |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Revision this describes              | `b4099f9e6b7f473fdc187f271fe17ea21d7c64f6` (`HEAD`) |
| Release presence is reported against | `v3.2.1`                                            |

**The register is a declaration, not a behaviour claim.** The command surface is built from `surface/dispatch-table.json`, so the register at a revision states what that revision exposes. It does not state that any of it works. Where this page and your binary disagree, **your binary is right**.

**No exit codes are listed per command.** The register's per-command exit tables are measurements of _v2_, and v3 does not reproduce them everywhere, so they are not published here as v3's contract. Every command follows the one surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes).

## The commands

| Command              | What it does                                                                                           | In v3.2.1 | Reads or writes | Undo       |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | --------------- | ---------- |
| `intent wb`          | The whiteboard: read the node boards, and send between them                                            | yes       | read            | --         |
| `intent wb status`   | List the registered nodes: role, status, heartbeat, and what each is working on                        | yes       | read            | --         |
| `intent wb show`     | Read one node's board: its header, its items, the messages still live, and a count of the handled ones | yes       | read            | --         |
| `intent wb ask`      | Send one message from the acting node into another node's board                                        | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent wb announce` | Send one message to every registered node but the sender                                               | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent wb add`      | Add an item to the acting node's own board                                                             | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent wb archive`  | Move one of the acting node's live items to archived                                                   | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb edit`     | Change the text of one of the acting node's items, live or archived, or of a message it sent           | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent wb pickup`   | Start a session: mark this node active, then its board and its peers' state                            | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb touch`    | Stamp the acting node's heartbeat                                                                      | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb release`  | Pause the acting node, stamping when it stopped                                                        | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb decide`   | Record a decision on the acting node's own board                                                       | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent wb claim`    | Add a steel thread, work package or issue to the acting node's claims                                  | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb unclaim`  | Drop a steel thread, work package or issue from the acting node's claims                               | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb clear`    | Mark every live message one sender sent the acting node handled                                        | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb register` | Register a node from its arguments, or the roster from each node's own board header                    | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent wb migrate`  | Carry one node's hand-authored board into the model                                                    | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |

## `intent wb`

The whiteboard: read the node boards, and send between them

```
intent wb <command>
```

|                 |                                                            |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| In `v3.2.1`     | yes                                                        |
| Reads or writes | read                                                       |
| Undo            | not applicable -- the register records this verb as a read |
| Over MCP        | no                                                         |

**Arguments**

| Argument  | Type         | Required | Values | Notes |
| --------- | ------------ | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| `command` | `subcommand` | yes      |        |       |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent wb --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## `intent wb ask`

Send one message from the acting node into another node's board

```

```

|                 |         |
| --------------- | ------- |
| In `v3.2.1`     | yes     |
| Reads or writes | mutate  |
| Undo            | one-way |
| Over MCP        | no      |

| Argument    | Type     | Required | Values | Notes |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| `recipient` | `node`   | yes      |        |       |

## `intent wb pickup`

Start a session: mark this node active, then its board and its peers' state

```
intent wb pickup [flags]
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.2.1`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | idempotent |
| Over MCP        | yes        |

**Flags**

| Flag        | Takes    | Default | What it does                                                                                                   |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--node`    | `string` |         | The moniker of the node picking up                                                                             |
| `--session` | `string` |         | This session's id, recorded on the node's header; without it, the CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID the process runs with |
| `--focus`   | `string` |         | One line saying what this node is on, recorded on its header                                                   |
| `--all`     | no       |         | List every message addressed to the node, handled ones included                                                |
| `--json`    | no       |         | Emit as JSON instead of prose                                                                                  |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent wb pickup --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## `intent wb register`

Register a node from its arguments, or the roster from each node's own board header

```
intent wb register [<moniker>] [flags]
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.2.1`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | idempotent |
| Over MCP        | no         |

**Arguments**

| Argument  | Type   | Required | Values | Notes |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| `moniker` | `node` | no       |        |       |

**Flags**

| Flag        | Takes    | Default | What it does                                                                            |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`    | `string` |         | The node's display name, eg "QA Claude" -- not its session name; given with `<moniker>` |
| `--role`    | `string` |         | The node's role, one word, eg `worker` -- not its moniker; given with `<moniker>`       |
| `--correct` | no       |         | Change a registered node's name and role to `--name` and `--role`, keeping its board    |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent wb register --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## Refusals

**There is no per-command refusal list, because the register does not carry one.** A row declares its path, arguments, flags, target, disposition, recoverability, MCP exposure and read-or-mutate, and nothing structural about what it refuses.

The estate-wide roster of refusal variants is in [what Intent ships at this revision](cut-surface.md), taken from a roster that declares itself exhaustive and is checked as one. **It is not attributed to commands anywhere**, and attributing it by reading the variant names would be a guess dressed as a reference.
